title: Administrator - Export Team
salary_text: £13 per hour (Onsite Canteen, onsite convenience store, 26 day)
description:
We're looking for an Export Coordinator / Administrator to join a busy team, supporting the worldwide export of spares and repairs. You'll play an important role in ensuring shipments are processed accurately, on time and in line with customer requirements and export regulations. Based in Yeovil, this is a temporary role and the team currently work hybrid, 3 days in the office and 2 days at home (training will be full time in the office).
What you'll be doing:
- Coordinating worldwide exports of spares and repairs to customers and suppliers.
- Preparing export documentation to meet HM Revenue & Customs and Department for Business & Trade requirements, as well as customer-specific requirements.
- Producing shipping documents that comply with contractual and country-specific regulations.
- Ensuring documentation meets Letter of Credit requirements where applicable.
- Completing export entries using the GTS system where required.
- Monitoring customer orders to ensure goods are despatched on time and in line with agreed service levels.
- Acting as a point of contact for internal departments, responding to queries efficiently.
- Keeping stakeholders updated on shipment progress and delivery arrangements.
- Ensuring export procedures, including export licences and commodity codes, are followed correctly.
- Liaising with packing contractors to ensure goods are prepared for shipment within agreed timescales.
- Booking air, sea and road freight with freight forwarders and customer-appointed agents.
- Checking freight invoices against agreed rates before processing for payment.
- Maintaining accurate export records and departmental documentation.
- Ensuring shipping documentation is issued and distributed in line with company procedures.
- Identifying opportunities to improve processes and ways of working.
- Supporting colleagues within the Export team and providing cover during periods of absence or increased workload.

What we're looking for:
- Previous experience in an Export Coordinator, Shipping Administrator, Logistics Administrator or similar administration role.
- Experience within a shipping or distribution environment would be beneficial.
- Strong administration and organisational skills.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Good attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks.
- Confident using Microsoft Word, Excel and SAP (SAP is desirable)
- A proactive approach with a focus on delivering excellent customer service.

title: Trust Operations Co-ordinator
description:
Trust Operations Co-ordinator

Education Sector Worle, North Somerset

Reed is delighted to be supporting a growing organisation within the education sector in the recruitment of a newly created Trust Operations Co-ordinator position.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a large and expanding multi-site organisation during a significant period of growth and transformation. Working closely with senior leaders, this role will sit at the heart of the organisation, acting as a key point of coordination across multiple locations and supporting the smooth running of central operations.

This is far more than a traditional administration role. Combining elements of Personal Assistant, Office Manager and Operations Co-ordinator, you'll become the organisational hub for senior leadership, helping to drive communication, collaboration and operational excellence across a network of schools.

The successful candidate will be joining at an exciting time, with the organisation continuing to grow and evolve. As this is a brand-new position, there is a genuine opportunity to make the role your own, build strong relationships with senior stakeholders and have a visible impact across the wider organisation.

The Key Details
- 30-37 hours per week
- Permanent contract
- Term Time + INSET Days + 2 Weeks During School Holidays
- Enjoy 11 of the 13 School Holiday Weeks Off Each Year
- £23,899 - £29,475 actual salary
- £32,597 - £35,413 Full-Time Equivalent (FTE)
- Annual incremental pay progression
- Predominantly based in Worle, North Somerset

The Role

You will provide high-level administrative and operational support to senior leaders whilst helping to coordinate activities across multiple sites.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Managing complex diaries, calendars and meeting schedules for senior leaders
- Acting as a central point of contact for staff, stakeholders and external partners
- Coordinating organisation-wide meetings, forums, events and conferences
- Managing central enquiries, inboxes and communications
- Preparing reports, presentations, briefings and key documentation
- Supporting the day-to-day operation of central hub facilities
- Coordinating room bookings, visitor management and logistics
- Supporting compliance, safeguarding and health & safety administration
- Building strong relationships with leaders and teams across multiple locations

About You

We're keen to speak with candidates who have experience within senior administration, executive support, office management or operations-based roles.

To be successful, you'll ideally have:
- Experience in a Senior Administrator, PA, Office Manager or Operations support role
- Strong diary and calendar management experience
- Excellent organisational and prioritisation skills
- The ability to manage multiple competing demands effectively
- Outstanding written and verbal communication skills
- Experience handling confidential and sensitive information
- Strong attention to detail and document accuracy
- A proactive and self-sufficient approach to work
- Confidence liaising with senior stakeholders
- A full UK driving licence and access to your own vehicle

Location

The role is predominantly based in Worle, North Somerset, with occasional travel required to three additional sites across South Gloucestershire and North Somerset.

Due to the multi-site nature of the role, candidates must hold a full UK driving licence and have access to their own vehicle.

The post-holder: Works in Workflow responsible for processing and managing all incoming correspondence (electronically and paper) including coding and keeping the patients records accurate and up to date. Works in Data responsible for inputting and updating medical data for an agreed set of patients, and all related administrative tasks. General administrative and clerical duties as requested. Works in Admin responsible for all onward referrals to Secondary Care and other relevant services using systems such as Cinapsis, E-Referrals etc. Organising the timely completion of private medical reports Works in Reception (although the applicant will not specifically work within reception, they would need to have an understanding of how reception works as there may be times that cover and support is needed) working with the Rapid Health triage system; dealing with enquiries; advising on doctors and nurses availability; recording and passing messages on accurately and efficiently; carrying out a range of related reception duties as appropriate. Working Hours and Work Schedule Surgery working week: 08.00 6.30pm Monday to Friday, 08.00 08.00 pm on selected dates. Shared rota with 4 other local practices. Working hours; normal working schedule between 08.30 and 17:00pm or 20.00 pm Monday to Friday as required. Occasional Saturdays throughout the year on a rota basis. Monday; Tuesday; Wednesday; Thursday; Friday: daily schedules to be determined. The post-holder will be required to cover for colleagues who are absent on annual leave or sickness. Duties and Responsibilities Sort all prescription requests, both electronic and manual guided by Pharmacy Team Record any acute prescriptions and pass to the pharmacy team for consideration. Contact patients (when requested) to pass on doctors instructions and requests. Add messages/instructions/date for future action to the medication screen. Sort and place prescriptions ready for collection or according to their destination. Process all information flowing from/to doctors and external institutions as appropriate. Check and process any electronic information as appropriate each day. Process all records from Primary Care Support England as appropriate. Enter appropriate x-ray results read codes and comments from doctors. Sort and distribute all processed, scanned and unscanned documents as appropriate. Add delivery/birth details on mothers and babys screens; including Hospital Unit No. Assist in the processing of Prior Notification Lists from Open Exeter in connection with cervical smears. Ensure correct forms are completed and signed by a GP and returned if a patient needs to be removed from the cervical smear recall list. Check lab links on the screen each day, match any unmatched patients. Undertake SNOMED coding into EMIS. Update, maintain, file and retrieve patient records as appropriate. Scan medical records and file into the EMIS system. Set up systems in preparation for the working day. To assist with the gathering of statistics and information when required. Process deceased patients notes when required. Carry out searches of computerised medical records as requested. Check address template regularly to delete any errors. Process new patient registrations and questionnaires. Process deductions of patient notes when a patient leaves the surgery. Process and manage queries relating to online access requests. Process and manage all incoming correspondence. Managing the diary recall system, to include adding requests onto ICE for blood tests and booking appointments. NHS App and Proxy Access Set up and management Diary Entries Recall Support (including Child Imms, Minor Ops & QOF/Recall) Referrals (ERS & 2WW) - Prepare, process and submit referrals accurately using NHS e-Referral Service (e-RS), Advice and Guidance and other referral pathways such as secure email. Process suspected cancer referrals using C the Signs. Ensure urgent suspected cancer referrals are submitted within required timescales. Cinapsis Referrals and Admin SARS Private Medical Reports Attend for staff training when necessary. Receive, sort and circulate/distribute post. Filing of paper medical records. Attend any other training courses deemed necessary by the Practice Manager or Operations Manager. Carry out any other duties as requested by the Practice Manager or Operations Manager. Other General Conditions Holiday entitlement is five working weeks per year (pro rata) plus any Bank Holidays that fall on a normal working day. All employees are required to adhere to the Health and Safety at Work Act (1974) The job description will be subject to periodic reviews and may be changed in consultation with the post holder. On Appointment the post holder must agree to abide by the Statement of Terms and Conditions of Service and the Contract requirements; all published Surgery protocols; policies; procedures; guidelines and work-rules; and any other approved instruction & documentation that may be amended and issued from time to time.

title: Bank Administrator
description: UNLOCK YOUR BEST WORK LIFE + make a difference for every patient We're looking for a friendly, organised and customer-focused Bank Administrator to join our team and help deliver an exceptional experience for our patients. As part of our Administration Team, you'll play a vital role in supporting the smooth day-to-day running of hospital services, ensuring patients, visitors and colleagues receive a professional, efficient and welcoming service at every interaction. You'll work across a variety of administrative functions, helping to keep patient pathways moving and supporting the delivery of outstanding patient care. This is a Bank role; however, we are particularly interested to hear from candidates who can commit to working at least 34 days per week, or who are specifically looking for regular weekend work. The role offers flexibility while providing valuable experience within a busy healthcare environment. As our Bank Administrator, you will be: Providing an efficient appointment booking service for patients across outpatient and theatre services. Handling telephone enquiries from patients, GP surgeries and colleagues in a professional and courteous manner. Supporting patients with appointment queries both over the phone and face-to-face. Contacting patients to offer earlier appointments and supporting the management of internal waiting lists. Processing referrals and maintaining accurate patient records using the Patient Administration System (PAS). Monitoring clinic and theatre lists to help maximise capacity and support RTT targets. Coordinating outpatient clinics and ensuring documentation is prepared and available when required. Working collaboratively with departments across the hospital to ensure patients receive a seamless service. For more information request a copy of the full job description from sarah.melder@practiceplusgroup.com
